name: Souhan no Idealism
source:
The protagonist (default name: Sei) was comforting her own heart with casual sex as usual.
But one night she was greeted by a white haired man dressed like a monk, and found herself tossed into a different world.
And the world was an incomprehensible one where people who attack her with the intent to kill would suddenly commit suicide...!?
Violence x Transfer to a different world x Obsession x otome game x more violence = a violent, messy tale of obsessive love!
Can the protagonist survive and safely return to her original world?
Or will she be unable to return? Or maybe, unwilling to?
This is a story where you deliver happiness.

(Although it shares the same setting as "Nail Lain", it is okay if you have not played it.)
translation:
主人公（默认姓名为圣依）像往常一样，用一夜情慰藉自己的内心。
然而某个夜晚，一名身着僧侣般服装的白发男子出现在她面前，她也随之被抛到了异世界。
这里的一切令人费解，怀着杀意袭击她的人，竟会突然自杀……！？
暴力×穿越异世界×执念×乙女游戏×更多暴力＝一个暴力而混乱的偏执爱情故事！
主人公能活下来，平安回到原来的世界吗？
还是无法回去？又或者，她会不愿回去？
这是一个由你传递幸福的故事。

（本作与《nail lain》共享世界观，不过没有玩过也不影响游玩。）
